judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A decent but ordinary sky snapshot with some cloud contrast, held back by flat light and distracting foreground objects.
strengths: contrast between dark upper cloud band and blue sky
distinct puffy cumulus in lower right
faint contrail adds a diagonal line
weaknesses: streetlights and building clutter the composition
